attacks.name: Bolts of Bedevilment
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, this character may Push the defender |!range_small|.
|!block| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Crimson Bands of Cyttorak
steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

|!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |*Mystic Binding|: After this attack is resolved, instead of inflicting the Stagger special condition, if the defender does not have an Activated token, this character may give it an Activated token.

superPowers.name: Judgment of the Vishanti (Affiliation: Defenders)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, after an attack made by an allied character is resolved, if that attack dealt |!damage| or if the defender has a |!threat| of 5 or more, the attacking character may use this |!leadership| ability. If they do, the defender gains the |§hex§Hex| special condition.

superPowers.name: Oshtur‘s Refuge
superPowers.body: This character or an allied character within |!range| 3 of this character removes up to 3 |!damage|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Hoggoth‘s Hoary Wisdom
superPowers.body: When this character or an allied character within |!range| 3 is targeted by an attack or would make a dodge roll, this character may use this superpower. This character adds 2 dice to the defense or dodge roll.

superPowers.name: Eye of Agamotto
superPowers.body: This character can modify and reroll |!failure| results. When this character is attacking, defending, or dodging, it may reroll all of its dice.

superPowers.name: Shield of the Seraphim
superPowers.body: Whenever this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least one |!block|.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side.
Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Injured side.
Oshtur‘s Refuge can now target allies within |!range| 3, instead of 2
Hoggoth‘s Hoary Wisdom can now be used on dodge rolls
Eye of Agamotto can now reroll dodge dice
The Judgment of the Vishanti Leadership ability was added
The Mystic Empowerment Leadership ability was removed. It allowed to choose the attack type once per Turn for 1 |!power|. Its Hex special rule only triggered if |!damage| was dealt
Bolts of Bedevilment was added the Pierce special rule
